primary_effort: Preserve the same organized rebound while conditionally accepting a little more self-generated landing momentum.
readiness_gate: Use the familiar-amplitude hold route unless actual records show E3 6/6 organized transitions and 3/3 final holds at that height, acceptable subsequent response and current readiness. If the gate is met, keep set 1 familiar and choose only one small, visibly controllable height increase for sets 2–3; record the chosen height/intent rather than assigning a universal percentage. Set 1 must also remain organized today. Do not increase load, contact count, rebound sequence length or directional distance with this change.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 jumps.** Controlled submaximal height; **20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Establish the terminal braking pattern before asking for rebounds. Use a smooth dip and arm swing, jump vertically, then let ankles, knees and hips yield together and hold 2 s. Keep pressure centered over both feet. Reduce height if the landing needs a step or the trunk folds; stop if control is not restored.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 8 low jumps**, continuous; **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Rehearse ankle-led elastic return with little hip/knee excursion before the larger multi-joint task. Stay tall, knees soft, feet under hips; rebound briskly without chasing height. Let the final landing settle. Reduce amplitude for heavy contacts or knee pumping; stop for persistent loss of rhythm.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — three connected jumps, conditional amplitude change
explosive.dose: **3 × 3 jumps = 9 landings / 6 transitions.** Set 1 at the documented familiar height; sets 2–3 may use one small coach-selected increase only if the gate is met. **120 s between sets and before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary anchor:** preserve coordinated yielding and prompt takeoff when slightly more self-generated landing momentum is introduced. Use natural arm swing, no gathering dip and a 2 s final hold. The added height must remain comfortably submaximal and must not produce a deeper collapse or progressively longer settling. Return to the familiar amplitude if those appear; do not add a test attempt.

explosive.name: Broad Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 jumps.** Modest forward distance with a brisk two-foot takeoff; **20 s between jumps; 90 s before E5.**
explosive.job: Absorb a forward component of momentum that E1/E3 do not provide. Land on two feet, bring the hips over the base and hold 2 s without shuffling. Reset by walking only after the area is clear. Shorten distance if the athlete falls forward or reaches the feet far ahead of the body.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — stick landing
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 landings per leg = 4 bounds.** Alternate receiving legs, fully resetting each time. **20 s between bounds; 90 s before E6.**
explosive.job: Accept lateral momentum on one leg while controlling the pelvis, knee and foot. Push from one leg to the other over a small distance, absorb and hold 2 s; this is a bound, not a side-step drill. Reduce distance for pelvic drop, knee collapse or a corrective hop.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 5 low hops per leg = 10 hops.** **60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Apply a small ankle rebound dose with the load carried by one support leg, after the main bilateral work. Keep the foot beneath the pelvis and knee softly organized; settle the fifth landing. Reduce hop height if the ankle rolls or the free leg flails. End the set if this remains uncontrolled.

replacement_routes.description: Familiar-height hold route has the same 37 landings, 21 transitions and 60 limb contacts; amplitude remains unchanged and is logged separately from the progression option.
Two-jump E3 regression: 34 landings, 20 bilateral + 14 single-leg, 18 transitions and 54 limb contacts. Same rest and estimated session allowance.

next_intended_job: Class 4 consolidates receiving positions across directions and trims overlapping impact/strength volume while retaining the vertical rebound anchor.
